newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sets accords with IADB to boost Latam links.
newsitem.headline: France sets accords with IADB to boost Latam links.

text.p: French finance minister Jean Arthuis and Inter-American Development Bank chairman Enrique Iglesias signed two accords on Thursday aimed at strengthening France's commercial ties with Latin America.

The first accord aims to create a fund of 20 million francs initially to finance feasibility studies for joint projects, and the second aims to increase France's presence in the region through IADB project co-financing, Arthuis said at a signing ceremony attended by several Latin American ministers.
"France is also Latin, and the deep roots that we share have kept our geographic distance and different histories from leading to incomprehension," Arthuis said.
"These accords symbolise France's desire for closer political and economic ties with the South American continent," he said.

Latin America, after a strong recovery, looks to be the world's second-fastest growth region after Asia, Arthuis said, and French industry appears insufficiently represented with roughly two percent of the market -- a level that has stagnated since 1990.
